subject: Renewal: priority support & latency SLO uplift
messages:
From: Oliver Zhang <oliver.zhang@polarisdata.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Janelle Park <janelle.park@polarisdata.com>
Date: 2026-08-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal conversation — priority support + latency targets

Hannah,

We’re approaching our renewal on 2026-11-01 and want to discuss moving to Redwood’s priority support tier and getting stronger latency SLOs for our peak inference workloads. Over the last 6 months we’ve tripled concurrent requests and expect a further 2x in Q4. Key asks:

- Guaranteed p95 latency <= 150ms for the dedicated model path (request sizes ~512 tokens)
- Dedicated reserved capacity uplift to cover +50% peak (with predictable overage pricing)
- 24/7 priority support and a direct on-call handoff during planned launches

We’re open to a multi-year commitment if the economics work. Can you outline the options (SLA addendum, capacity pricing, and any onboarding windows) and share a redline-friendly SLA addendum?

Thanks,
Oliver
Head of ML Eng, Polaris Data

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Zhang <oliver.zhang@polarisdata.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-30T10:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal conversation — priority support + latency targets

Hi Oliver — thanks for the clear summary. We can support the ask but want to confirm a couple of details before I share a formal addendum:

1) Is the +50% peak uplift relative to your current committed capacity or relative to observed 99th-percentile peak in July?
2) Do you expect the 512-token distribution to be steady or spike (i.e., will you have a mix of short/long requests during launch windows)?

Operationally, Marissa will scope the support onramp (SLA ops roster, escalation path) and Ben will partner on capacity sizing and pricing. I’ll put together a proposed SLA addendum and a capacity projection workbook for your review — can we aim for a call on Thursday 2026-09-02?

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Growth — Enterprise, Redwood Inference
P: 415-555-0186
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-31T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Renewal conversation — priority support + latency targets

Hannah / Ben — forwarding Oliver’s note. Quick ops take: to promise p95 <=150ms at 512 tokens we’ll need to reserve a mix of A100-equivalent capacity and enable aggressive prefix caching for their workload. Questions for pricing:

- Are they willing to commit to a 12- or 24-month reserved block? We can offer a 10% price reduction on 24-month.
- We can include a 2-week onramp for runbook handoffs and canary testing (zero-cost).

Ben — can you draft a capacity uplift table (current committed, projected peak, recommended reserved + burst) and include our proposed overage rate for additional RUs? I’ll assemble the ops roster and an escalation flow to include in the addendum.

—Marissa
Director, Customer Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-31T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Renewal conversation — priority support + latency targets

Marissa / Hannah — drafting the numbers. Summary so far from telemetry:
- Baseline committed: 180 RUs (avg observed peak 200 RUs last week)
- Expected Q4 spike: estimate +100 RUs (conservative) => peak ~300 RUs
- Recommendation: reserve 270 RUs (50% uplift on baseline, covers most spikes) + 100 RUs burst pool with overage at $0.045/RU.

Pricing options:
- 12-month reservation: list price -> $0.12/RU-hour; with priority support + SLA addendum => +12% premium
- 24-month reservation: $0.108/RU-hour (10% discount) with SLA addendum included; we can offer 1 month of free burst credits in Q4 if they sign by 2026-10-15.

Latency SLOs: we can commit p95 <=150ms on the reserved path if they adopt our recommended batching and enable prefix cache. For mixed-request spikes we’ll include an automatic fallback to a compatible model variant (documented in the addendum).

I’ll attach a workbook with projection scenarios. Ben
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Zhang <oliver.zhang@polarisdata.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Janelle Park <janelle.park@polarisdata.com>
Date: 2026-09-02T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Renewal conversation — priority support + latency targets

Oliver — thanks for the quick responses on the call earlier today. Per our discussion, summary & next steps below: 

Summary of proposal
- Capacity: reserve 270 RUs (covers ~90% forecasted peaks) + 100 RUs burst pool.
- Pricing: 24-month reserved term at $0.108/RU-hour (10% discount) + priority support premium (one-line SLA addendum). Q4 sign-by incentive: 1 month of burst credits.
- SLA: p95 latency target <= 150ms on the reserved path for requests <=512 tokens when Redwood batching + prefix cache enabled. Automatic fallback to compatible model variant if capacity constrained (documented failover behavior).
- Support: 24/7 priority support, named escalation contacts, and a monitored on-call handoff during major launches (2-week onramp).

Next steps
1) I’ve attached the capacity projection workbook (Polaris_capacity_projection_Q4.xlsx) and a redline-friendly addendum (Redwood_SLA_Addendum_v1.2.pdf). Please review and send any redlines.
2) If the commercial terms look good, we’ll raise a managed-deal entry in HubSpot and circulate a DocuSign link for the 24-month amendment. Link: https://www.docusign.com/sign/ABC-Polaris-SLA
3) Technical onramp: Marissa will schedule a 2-week canary window with your platform team to validate p95 during synthetic peak tests.

Oliver — can you confirm the sign-by decision maker and whether your procurement team needs legal review before we send the DocuSign envelope? We’ll hold the Q4 incentive until 2026-10-15.

Thanks — looking forward to closing this forward.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Growth — Enterprise, Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.com | (415) 555-0186
